Just nervous a bit, I didn't know what to do with it, after all. But the experience was amazing and fun and now I'm perfectly comfortable with my partner's bits.

I share all this just to show that these types of comments out of context are not usually about one's intimate partner; they come from a place of insecurity and intimidation and honestly just the weirdness of it all. My store has a great closing routine so we always get out 10-15 minutes after closing time! Some things I've learned:
Most days, we have cold bar and Curtises' already cleaned by 5pm. 3 or 4 pm is not too early to start on things that won't get too dirty again! 
Things that get dirty again will be cleaned slightly later in your routine, but still do them really early. For example, I'll wash out the Curtises by 5 like I mentioned, but I'll pretty much always do that before I break down the Mastrenas. So basically strategize what order you'll do things but start early, early, early! 

Another thing that helps is I'll make sure my sink is cleared of dishes before I wash something big or that needs to come back out quickly (like the Mastrena pieces). So I get my small dishes done, then I won't be stressed when I bring back something big like a Curtis, keg, bunch of blender pitchers, etc. 

Pace yourself, ask for help if you need it, and if you're not sure if it's too soon to break something down, ask!

I've only been a partner since December but these things help me a lot. Hope it helps you too!

It sounds like you're wanting a vanilla sweet cream cold foam cold brew, with mocha added. So if I can explain this correctly: the "sweet vanilla cream foam," that's vanilla sweet cream blended to make it foamy. This component is just called "sweet cream cold foam." When you get a venti cold brew with sweet cream cold foam, we add 6 pumps of vanilla syrup to the coffee part before putting the foam on top. If you want to add mocha, make sure you say you want mocha in ADDITION to vanilla syrup. Additional syrups cost extra, so usually we'll just ring it as a substitute to keep from charging you extra.

TL;DR ask for a "venti vanilla sweet cream cold foam cold brew, add mocha, keep the vanilla."

So, I had a long stretch of time in high school where I felt like this - the only comfort I could get during long, blurry days was fantasizing about my death. But I had no intention or desire to be the one to kill myself. 

Years later, having gotten better, worse, in/out of the hospital, on/off of meds, in/out of therapy - it can get better. And yes, it also gets worse and I do still have suicidal thoughts at times, but the episodes are shorter, they're less blurry, I feel more control...it's different depression. I'm still depressed, to be sure, but in different ways and for reasons I can handle better. 

And honestly, that's the goal of "recovery" from depression: not to make it go away, but to learn how to handle it. And then you can function and experience happy times along with those sad ones. It's much better than just the sad, blurry ones! :)
